package.name: demo_perception
package.description: Deterministic synthetic-detection stub for the Aquila AM69 ROS 2 demo (ML3). Consumes /demo/camera/image_raw, publishes /demo/perception/detections, and adapts those detections into a PointCloud2 the Nav2 costmap can consume. Separated from day one because it defines the OTA update granularity: the future TIDL/NPU inference replaces this package as a container swap.
